name: Apply Ceiling Primer (Spray + Backroll, Combined Wall+Ceiling Pass)
intent: Ceiling prime variant for the pre-trim NC workflow where walls and ceiling are primed in one continuous spray pass. Identical to MOD_APPLY_CEIL_PRIME_SPRAY_BACKROLL except drops the post-spray wall-line cut-in — wall spray covers that edge, so no dedicated cut-in is needed. Rates and modifier sensitivities match the standalone ceiling prime module so estimation remains consistent.
doctrine: Combined-pass variant of MOD_APPLY_CEIL_PRIME_SPRAY_BACKROLL. Scenarios that match ctx.prime_mode === 'combined' use this module instead of the standard version. The only difference is the absence of the wall-line cut-in task — in the pre-trim combined workflow, the painter sprays walls and ceiling as one field, so there's no ceiling/wall boundary to dedicated-cut. Baseline rates currently identical to non-combined (will be tuned via Modifier UI once author has painter data for combined pace). Per-task texture eligibility overrides can still be added via the Modifier UI if spray needs to opt out of FAC_TEXTURE on this variant.
